# xparsermodget98 v0.4 validation report

## Lineage

- Parent baseline: `xparsermodget98_v0.3_FROZEN.zip`
- Frozen parent SHA-256: `e97241f954f15700944002ce3445d6a59dde57a7e92983eb3b1d28b9fbd88a9f`
- The parent artifact was not modified. v0.4 was developed in a separate working tree.

## Runtime integration additions

- provider-based sequential I/O (`xp_io`)
- stdio compatibility adapter (`xp_open_file`)
- memory provider (`xp_io_init_memory`)
- provider-driven MSZIP
- parser budgets and usage telemetry
- structured diagnostics
- unknown/custom semantic token passthrough

## Format additions

- VertexDuplicationIndices
- DeclData
- VertexElement fields: Type, Method, Usage, UsageIndex
- FVFData
- full unsigned text DWORD parsing

The raw DWORD bodies of DeclData/FVFData are reported without converting them to
renderer-specific vertex formats.

## Rig / animation / UV hardening

Targeted runtime audits were added after model playback exposed integration
errors that a parse-only corpus cannot detect.

### `dogs/dog.x`

- 569 vertices; all 569 are weighted.
- 22 SkinWeights blocks; all 22 bone names resolve to Frames.
- exactly one influence per vertex, matching the file header.
- every vertex weight sum is exactly 65536 (Q16.16 1.0).
- `matrixOffset * boneCombined` reproduces identity bind pose with maximum
  error 2 Q16.16 integer units.
- integrated `AnimationSet0`: 26 target tracks, raw tick range 0..53.
- key semantics: 349 rotation keys + 349 position keys.
- no AnimTicksPerSecond object; raw ticks are retained without inventing a rate.

### `Zombie Apocalypse/mobzombie1.X`

- 2854 vertices; all 2854 are weighted.
- 25 SkinWeights blocks; all 25 bone names resolve to Frames.
- 1..4 influences per vertex; maximum 4 matches XSkinMeshHeader.
- weight sums are 65535..65537 (1 Q16.16 unit from exact 1.0 at worst).
- integrated `Anim-1`: 34 target tracks, raw tick range 0..3440.
- 116994 legacy raw type-4/16-value keys are normalized to matrix semantics
  while preserving raw type 4 and a compatibility flag.
- all 34 first matrix keys match their target FrameTransformMatrix exactly,
  proving that treating them as an extra delta multiply would double the pose.
- no AnimTicksPerSecond object; raw ticks are retained without inventing a rate.

### UV / texture integration

- raw MeshTextureCoords are preserved even outside [0,1].
- MaterialWrap and MeshFaceWraps are now decoded explicitly.
- `xp_uv_dx_to_gl()` flips only V (`1-v`) and deliberately preserves tiling.
- stable Frame IDs were added so anonymous/duplicate Frames cannot collapse in
  a name-only runtime hierarchy.

## Corpus regression

199 external `.x` assets were executed with the v0.4 decoder:

- PASS: 196
- FAIL: 3

The failures are unchanged from v0.3:

- `hostage.x`
- `scout1.X`
- `slowzombie3.X`

They fail inside damaged DEFLATE data and remain intentionally rejected as
`XP_EFORMAT`.

## Build matrix

Both GCC and Clang pass all 8 combinations of:

- XP_ENABLE_TEXT = 0/1
- XP_ENABLE_BINARY = 0/1
- XP_ENABLE_MSZIP = 0/1

Compiler policy:

```text
-std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic
```

Total strict builds: 16/16.

## Sanitizers

- UBSan: 199-file corpus, zero findings.
- ASan+UBSan: provider/extensions/budget harness + rig/UV/animation semantics harness + representative dog/zombie assets + the three malformed compressed assets, zero sanitizer findings.

## Protocol scan

Implementation/public headers contain:

- no malloc/calloc/realloc/free calls
- no C float/double declarations
- no long long declarations

All real-valued model output remains Q16.16 `xp_fx32`.
